elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each party's aggregate liability)
elements.evidence: "EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BETWEEN THE PARTIES UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" — all amounts, and an event anchor rather than the claim

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, taken as the greater of the two limbs

elements.evidence: "NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "a Party's breach of its confidentiality ... obligations" within "Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Amounts payable by Kubient to Customer under Section 5 are not subject to this limitation." — addresses Vendor-to-Customer payments, not Customer's payment obligations
cap is "THE GREATER OF (I) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE ... AND (II) USD 1,000,000", i.e. an amounts-based greater-of cap, not a straight 12 months' fees cap

reasons: The preferred fee limb is mis-stated: it caps at "THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BETWEEN THE PARTIES" measured "PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM"; the position requires fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim. Replace with 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'.

The payment-obligations element is not delivered: the insertion excludes "Amounts payable by Kubient to Customer under Section 5" from the cap, which is the opposite direction. Add that Customer's payment obligations (amounts due under the Agreement) are not 'damages' for cap purposes.

Fallback is also not met on its own terms because the cap is a greater-of construct incorporating the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor rather than a straight 12 months' fees cap; the two levels cannot be blended.

Mutuality, the consequential-damages exclusion and the full preferred carve-out list (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) are all present and unobjectionable.
The insertion is a targeted new subsection (b) for an absent cap and leaves Section 7(a) and surrounding terms untouched, so scope and intent are preserved.
